units: Coordinates: x, y, z voxel indices (level 0) of the public PHerc0841 2.403 um volume 20260319124803-2.403um-0.2m-77keV-masked.zarr (s3://vesuvius-challenge-open-data/PHerc0841/volumes/). Strip coordinates: s (mm) along the strip axis t, n (mm) along the strip normal n, from the frame origin o; a point (s, n) is o + (s * t + n * n) * 1000 / 2.403 voxels.
station_rule: stations k = 0..6 at s = seed_s + (0, 0.75, 1.5, 2.25, 3.0, 3.75, 4.5) mm; k = 0 is the shared w00 start; k = 1..6 are scored
w00_surface: organizers' w00 mesh on the 2.403 um volume: s3://vesuvius-challenge-open-data/PHerc0841/segments/20260220213127-w00/mesh/20260220213127-on-20260319124803-2.403um.tifxyz/ (x.tif, y.tif, z.tif, meta.json)
